name: Spanish
notes: Five courses in Spanish language, literature and culture, selected with the Spanish advisor.
SPAN 101 and SPAN 102 do NOT count toward the Spanish minor - the groups below start at SPAN 151.
The Spanish minor allows a maximum of TWO transfer courses (AP, IB or education abroad).
The one four-credit SPAN 202+ course must be taken at the University of Rochester regardless of study-abroad credits - the planner cannot tell where a course was taken.

requirementGroups.label: One 4-credit SPAN course numbered 202 or above, taken at UR
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All minors, regardless of study-abroad credits, must take a minimum of one four-credit Spanish elective course numbered SPAN 202 or above at the University of Rochester.

requirementGroups.label: Four further Spanish courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A total of five courses in Spanish language, literature, and culture, to be selected in consultation with the Spanish advisor. A minor may start with SPAN 151 and can include SPAN 152, SP 200, and other 200-level courses.
